correctness.rationale: The explicit group law on 27 elements and four generators yield distance shells (1,4,8,12,2) by independently enumerated BFS. All nine one-dimensional characters give the scalar sectors 4+8a+12b+2c (trivial), 1−4a+2c (4 copies), and −2+2a−3b+2c (4 copies), where a=2^p,b=3^p,c=4^p. The conjugate three-dimensional irreps yield three real eigenvalue branches 2a−c−2 and 1−a−c±sqrt(3)(1+a−2b), each multiplicity six, totaling 27. The controlling fourfold branch F=2c+2a−3b−2 increases through a unique zero p* in (2/3,7/10), from convexity in a=2^p; exact rational-power endpoint bounds keep all other branches strictly negative there. For smaller p the fractional-power Schoenberg strictness theorem applies; larger p has a positive centered F. Thus the endpoint nullity is four and squared-Euclidean rank 22 versus 26 below. Positive e^{-t d^p} for all t uses the CND equivalence, while t>log26 follows from strict diagonal dominance for every p. Independent BFS/27×27 eigenvalue checks at p=.5,p*,.8 corroborated; full intervals rely on the analytic factorization and bounds.
